title.rendered: Sealed by the Spirit He Promised: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God identified you as His own by giving you the Holy Spirit. The Spirit is the guarantee. Your inheritance is sealed by the very presence of God inside you.

content.rendered:
God identified you as His own by giving you the Holy Spirit. The Spirit is the guarantee. Your inheritance is not pending, conditional, or fragile. It is sealed by the very presence of God inside you.

The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, May 27, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“And when you believed in Christ, he identified you as his own by giving you the Holy Spirit, whom he promised long ago. The Spirit is God’s guarantee that he will give us the inheritance he promised and that he has purchased us to be his own people.”
Ephesians 1:13–14 (NLT)

Today’s Message

Paul uses the language of sealing here. In the ancient world, a seal meant three things. First, ownership: a mark pressed into wax or clay to declare, “this is mine.” Second, authentication: a seal certified that the document or treasure inside was genuine and not tampered with. Third, security: a sealed shipment was safely transported under the authority of the one whose mark it bore.

When God gave you the Holy Spirit, He sealed you in all three ways at once.

You are His. The Spirit who lives in you is the mark of ownership that no devil, no doubt, no failure, no enemy can remove. Romans 8:9 says if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Him. The reverse is also true. If you have the Spirit, you belong. You are not a visitor in the family of God. You are a child marked with the family seal.

You are authentic. The Spirit is God’s certification that your faith in Christ is real. Your salvation is not a counterfeit you have to prove. You do not have to manufacture spiritual experiences to verify what God has already verified. The Spirit Himself bears witness with your spirit that you are a child of God. You are who He says you are.

You are secured. The Spirit is the “guarantee” of your inheritance. The Greek word is arrabon—an earnest, a down payment, the first installment that guarantees the full payment is coming. The Spirit in you is the first installment of heaven, the in-breaking of eternity into your right now. The full inheritance is on its way. You will not be lost in transit.

This is not theology to admire from a distance. This is your address. Today, when the enemy whispers that you are not really saved, that your faith is not enough, that God might change His mind—point to the seal. The Spirit who lives in you is the answer. You are owned by the Father. You are authenticated by the Spirit. You are secured by the blood of Jesus. Three witnesses. One verdict. Yours.

Prayer

Father, thank You that You did not leave my salvation to my own strength to maintain. You sealed me with Your Spirit. I am Yours. I am genuine. I am secured. Help me walk today with the confidence of one who knows where he belongs and Whose she is. Quiet every voice that argues against the seal. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am sealed by the Holy Spirit. I belong to the Father. My faith is genuine. My inheritance is guaranteed. I am not a visitor in the family of God. I am a child, marked, certified, and secured by the very presence of God in me.
